observations.creature_of_fenkenstrain: Recover the body parts separately from the lightning conductor. Complete by pickpocketing the doctor's Ring of charos after speaking to the creature.
observations.garden_of_tranquillity: The three crop errands, potted cutting, garden plant groups and post-quest white fruit use independent clocks. Statue deliveries can occur during growth. Fruit picking is its own Varrock Medium task.
observations.ghosts_ahoy: Worship, gate fees, boat fares and Ectophial travel have distinct records. The activated Ring of charos is an optional fare reduction.
observations.animal_magnetism: The undead chickens cost 20 ecto-tokens. The reward records ownership of a device and documents the two Ranged thresholds.
observations.shades_of_mortton: Repair the temple, bless olive oil and cremate the shade. The separate Serum 208 action opens permanent access to Razmire's shops.
observations.haunted_mine: Send the fungus through the cart system, collect it through the dry route, and use the lift promptly. A ball of wool turns the completion shard into a separate Salve amulet.
observations.lair_of_tarn_razorlor: Fight both of Tarn's forms, then collect his diary. Enchanting the amulet is an optional follow-up.
observations.tears_of_guthix: The swamp entrance uses a fixed rope and a lit lantern. The sapphire lantern crosses the chasm so the player can carve the bowl. Completion unlocks access to the weekly activity.
